pubsub_topic.description: The Pub/Sub topic to send notifications to. Format: projects/[project_id]/topics/[topic].
pubsub_topic.rationale: Notifications may contain sensitive findings. Sending to insecure or unauthorized topics risks exposing security data to unintended recipients.

streaming_config.description: Configuration for triggering streaming-based notifications. Determines which findings are sent.
streaming_config.rationale: Defines which findings trigger notifications. Weak, missing, or overly broad filters can either exclude critical findings or generate noise.

filter.description: Expression to filter findings for notification. Supports logical operators and comparison operators.
filter.rationale: A proper filter ensures only relevant and high-severity findings are sent. Poor filters can miss important issues or overwhelm teams with unnecessary alerts.

config_id.description: Unique identifier for the notification config within the project.
config_id.rationale: Ensures uniqueness and prevents conflicts, but does not directly impact security posture.

description.description: Optional description of the notification config (max 1024 characters).
description.rationale: Descriptions are informational only and do not affect security or functionality.

project.description: The project in which the notification config is defined. If not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Specifies scope but does not directly impact security posture.
